item.title: Why these Eastern Ontario beekeepers dread the high-speed rail megaproject
item.description: The owners of the Gibbs Honey apiary at Vankleek Hill find themselves within the corridor proposed for Alto's high-speed rail line.

item.title: New Ottawa bakery mills fresh heritage flour that might change how you think about bread
item.description: Almanac Grain, the only urban mill in the region, has opened a café in Little Italy. Their stone-milled croissants are reason enough to visit but what you learn about flour might stick with you longer.

item.title: Feds nominate new budget watchdog after position briefly left vacant
item.description: The government has nominated senior public servant Annette Ryan to the role.

item.title: Ottawa Senators will be without top defenceman Jake Sanderson indefinitely
item.description: Coach Travis Green said that the star defenceman is "week to week" after suffering an injury Saturday against the Seattle Kraken.

item.title: Sens 1-on-1: TSN’s Martin Biron talks Sabres surge, the trade deadline and why he’s high on the Sens
item.description: Catchup with the latest episode of Sens 1-on-1 with Bruce Garrioch

item.title: OCDSB reverses decision, opens kindergarten registration at four schools
item.description: Without a new stream of students entering several Ottawa alternative schools, parents feared the schools could close.

item.title: Long periods of freezing rain in forecast for Ottawa this week
item.description: The freezing rain could last up to a full 24 hours in some areas, the weather agency said, with ice buildup of 10 to 20 mm

item.title: Ottawans should brace for higher gas, grocery bills as oil prices soar: economists
item.description: Oil prices crossed the $100 U.S. threshold early Monday morning, the highest prices seen since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022

item.title: Two arrested after bank robbery in Clarence-Rockland
item.description: At about 9:25 a.m. on Feb 27, OPP officers received a report that a robbery was in progress at a financial institution in Clarence-Rockland

item.description: The veteran backup made 16 stops in the victory
